Product_Description: We teamed up with Virat Kohli aka 'The Run Machine' to create an energy drink with natural caffeine, that can keep up with his demands.
Manufacturer: Ash Panam Foods & Beverages Pvt. Ltd.
Ingredients: Purified Water, Sucrose, Glucose, Carbon dioxide, Acidulant Citric Acid (INS 330), Taurine, Acidity Regulators Sodium Citrates (INS 331) & Magnesium Carbonates (INS 504), Colour Caramel (INS 150a), Caffeine, Glucuronolactone, Inositol, Vitamins (B3, B5, B6, B2 & B12).
Nutritional_Details: NUTRITIONAL INFORMATION per 100ml (approx. values): Energy (48 kcal), Protein (0.5 g), Total Carbohydrates (11 g), Of Which Sugar (11 g), Fat (0 g), Taurine (400 mg), Caffeine (30 mg), Glucuronolactone (24 mg), Inositol (20 mg), Vitamin B3 (3.6 mg), Vitamin B5 (2 mg), Vitamin B6 (0.4 mg), Vitamin B2 (0.06 mg), Vitamin B12 (0.2 μg).
Usage_Details: NOT RECOMMENDED FOR CHILDREN, PREGNANT OR LACTATING WOMEN AND PERSONS SENSITIVE TO CAFFEINE NOT TAKING SUGAR PER DAY.
Storage_Instructions: Store in cool and dry place. Avoid from sunlight.
